answer: Agents must reserve 1,000 slots of dedicated service capacity as a primary register to maintain a heartbeat pulse of activity. This reservation forces a unique occupancy, for parallel waiting alone cannot mimic the cost of distinct service slots. A verifier monitors each pigment of assigned memory for cross-contamination; any relic of shared occupancy results in a permanent prune. Honest agents pay once, whereas 1,000 fakes incur bankruptcy.
